## Summary

Explain the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. For calculation changes, include an
independently derived expected answer and a regression test.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I have not included credentials, customer data, or confidential datasets.
- [ ] User-facing text is updated in English and Indonesian where applicable.
- [ ] I edited source files rather than generated dist files.

## Maintainer integration

This repository is currently exported from selected canonical product paths.
Before the next export, record the corresponding source change in orebit-ops,
or explain why this PR needs no carry-back. Do not paste private links or data
that contributors cannot use. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
